claim: ARIADNA v2.2 is approved for internal release on 1 December 2026. v2.1 remains the official evaluation snapshot; v2.2 is a maintenance and user-experience version.
evidence: v2.2 adds explained abstention, one-dimension clarifications and the new conflicting-current-evidence reason. We must decide whether it is ready for internal release.
On the reserved maintenance set, it achieves 85.1 percent correct abstention, 8.4 percent unnecessary abstention and 69.3 percent accuracy on answerable questions.
These figures do not come from the v2.1 test set and do not replace the official benchmark results: recall@10 of 79.5 percent, MRR of 0.638 and accuracy of 68.2 percent.
Guide 1.3 contains five reasons, evidence rules, human review and twenty bilingual examples. Final agreement on reasonCode is 0.92.
The v2.2 image is separated from v2.1 and experimental branches. The official test set remains encrypted and is not required to run abstention functions.
Documentation distinguishes stable release from maintenance, official results from supplementary analysis and public data from restricted sets.
Eighty-nine percent understood the abstention reason, 85 percent identified when human review was required and average trust was 4.4 out of 5.
Only minor wording and post-release follow-up actions. They do not affect the package.
